description: TY2026: SS 163(j) binds. Gross 2,000,000, ordinary 500,000, interest 600,000; avg gross receipts 40M exceeds the $32M 2026 SS 448(c) threshold. EBITDA-based ATI (OBBBA-permanent) = 1,500,000 -> 30% = 450,000 allowed (150,000 disallowed carries forward, untracked). TI = 1,050,000 -> $220,500.00.
